_note: Edit freely. 'image' = optional file name inside the images folder (PNG/GIF, ~200x200). {hours} and {activity} are auto-filled.

characters.name: Mass Hero Veera
break_lines: Mass-u time! Stand up, hero. The ledger can wait 5 minutes.
Even heroes take a breather before the climax. Break time!
Style-a stretch pannu! Your back is the real boss today.
Reconciliation can wait. Your eyes cannot. Look away from the screen!
long_work_lines: {hours}h on the laptop! Even the hero rests before the fight scene.
{hours} hours non-stop? That is not hard work, that is hard on your health!
water_lines: Hero fuel check: one glass of water, right now!
Water first, then the next file. Deal?
meal_lines: Hero needs a proper meal before the next scene. Go eat!
posture_lines: Hero posture check! Chin up, shoulders back, chest out!
Slouching is for villains. Sit tall like a boss!
done_lines: Super! Back to the filing, now with fresh energy.
That's the spirit. Due date, we are ready!

characters.name: Comedy King Kuttan
break_lines: Your chair is jealous of how much time you spend with Excel. Go meet your legs!
Portal is slow? Good, use that time to drink water instead!
Even the laptop gets a restart. You deserve one too!
Breaking news: your neck has filed an objection. Please attend the hearing (stretch).
long_work_lines: {hours} hours sitting! Your chair should start charging you rent.
{hours}h at this? Even the laptop fan is tired of you!
water_lines: Your water bottle is feeling ignored. Make it happy!
Hydration audit: zero entries found. Please drink.
meal_lines: Lunch is not an optional return. File it on time!
posture_lines: Why are you curving like a parenthesis '('? Sit straight like an 'I'!
Neck check! You're leaning into the screen like you're trying to enter the matrix.
done_lines: Nice! Your body just got an input tax credit.
Break accepted without scrutiny. Carry on!

characters.name: Audit Partner Vikram
break_lines: Material weakness detected in your ergonomics! Take a 5-minute remediation break.
We need an unqualified opinion on your health before we sign off this working paper.
IFRS 16 capitalizes leases, not your spine. Stand up and stretch!
Even the sharpest balance sheet review fails with fatigued eyes. Step away for {activity}.
long_work_lines: {hours} hours continuous vouching? That's a high audit risk for errors. Mandatory rest!
Going concern doubt raised on your energy levels after {hours}h. Recharge immediately.
water_lines: Liquidity ratio is dropping! Inject 250ml of H2O into cash and cash equivalents.
Hydration check: reconcile your daily water intake now.
meal_lines: Time to accrue some energy. Close the trial balance and go have your meal!
posture_lines: Internal control deficiency: rounded shoulders and forward head tilt. Correct immediately!
True and fair view requires sitting upright at 90 degrees.
done_lines: Audit adjustment posted. You are balanced and ready to roll!
Review cleared with zero review notes. Back to the portfolio!

characters.name: Mentor Guru
break_lines: A calm mind files returns without errors. Pause and breathe.
Health is the first asset on every balance sheet. Protect it.
Rest is not a delay. It is part of the work.
Close your eyes for a moment. The deadline will still be there, and you will be sharper.
long_work_lines: You have worked {hours} hours. A tired mind makes costly mistakes. Rest now.
Wise people schedule rest before the body demands it.
water_lines: A glass of water clears the mind. Drink slowly.
meal_lines: Nourish the body so the mind can work. Time to eat.
posture_lines: Align your spine, relax your jaw, and drop your shoulders.
Notice the tension in your neck. Breathe in and lengthen your spine.
done_lines: Well done. A rested mind is a precise mind.

characters.name: Lady Superstar Devi
break_lines: Boss, you are a pro. Pros take breaks. Up you get!
Hydrate, stretch, repeat. That is how champions beat due dates.
No excuses today. 5 minutes for your health, starting now!
Your posture called. It wants a word with you.
long_work_lines: {hours} hours in? Time to power down for a bit, champion.
Hard work is great. Burnout is not. Take your break!
water_lines: Sip up, boss. Your brain runs on it.
meal_lines: Skipping meals is not a strategy. Go eat, champion!
posture_lines: Power posture! Unclench your jaw, drop your shoulders, sit tall.
You're hunching, champion! Reset that spine.
done_lines: Strong move! Now go crush that deadline.
That's how it's done. Proud of you!

characters.name: Cool Cop Arjun
break_lines: Attention! Sitting for too long is an offence. Step away from the desk.
Order: stand up, stretch, and report back in 5 minutes.
Case file: your back pain. Evidence: 3 hours of sitting. Verdict: take a break!
long_work_lines: {hours} hours non-stop. Your health is under arrest by your workload. Release it!
water_lines: Water check, officer! One glass, no excuses.
meal_lines: Mealtime patrol: you are still at your desk. Go eat.
posture_lines: Patrol alert: illegal slouching detected at your desk! Straighten up!
Hands off the keyboard for 5 seconds—fix your neck angle, officer!
done_lines: Break completed. You may resume duty.

characters.name: Amma Care
break_lines: Kutty, ee screen nokki irunnu kannu pokum. Oru break edukku!
Ithiri neram ezhunnelkku, onnu nadakku. Pinne joli cheyyam.
Muthukinu vedana varum, iruppu mathi. Onnu stretch cheyyu.
long_work_lines: {hours} manikkoor aayi iruppu thudangiyittu. Ippol thanne break edukku!
posture_lines: Kutty, valanju irikkathe! Nere irunnu joli cheyyu.
Kazhuthu vedana varum ketto, nere irikku.
